policy: No silent coercion. Preserve imported fields and provenance. Contradictory aliases require review and suspend dependent suggestions.

canonical_fields.stage: venture or operating stage in its explicit scope
canonical_fields.scale_acquisition_requested: Boolean request for a material acquisition commitment; capped experiments do not automatically set this true

aliases.requires: Same venture/segment scope; disagreement with an existing stage is a conflict.
Both fields refer to the same material request, not a bounded learning test.

conditional_aggregation.unsupported: Other repeatability scopes (delivery, one-off acquisition, unit economics) cannot be mapped to retention. Retain unknown. A value outside the listed map is not automatically sufficient.
conditional_aggregation.claim: This mapping chooses a cautionary evidence task. It does not prove low retention, failed PMF or any causal diagnosis.

status_policy: Observation status, recency/conflict and claim confidence are independent axes. Never map observed or corroborated directly to high confidence. Existing detailed startup evidence labels remain in their original fields until a reviewed mapping is supplied.
